items.name: IN FLIGHT PLANNING / FORMATION CONSISTENCY
execution: SP performs in flight planning, taking into consideration changes in mission profile, maneuver sequence, energy conservation and fuel management.

general_criteria.text: Adjusts mission profile depending on meteorological conditions, fuel and time constraints and mission objectives.

For the time being a leader of the formation, adjusts the execution of the profile on the time specified during the briefing, so as to take advantage of the allocated fuel in the best way, taking into consideration the weather conditions as well as the assigned area (vertical and lateral limits).
Throughout the duration of his formation leadership, he monitors, controls and takes into account the wingman.
Keeps the formation flexible and consistent despite the various external flight conditions and breaks out when required, in accordance with the manuals and the briefing.
He takes into account the position of No2 in relation to the sun and the local area and performs the appropriate maneuver.
He performs smoothly the above maneuvers, informing the wingman (by visual signs or by radio) for any upcoming major data flight changes without causing him any problems of staying in place.
During the maneuvers he remains always predictable and his effect on the A/C’s flight controls is smooth and progressive, without affecting the proper execution of the exercises.
He checks at any time the position of No2 and he has a clear understanding of how it moves in space.
He provides the wingman with all required instructions and information.
He completes his task smoothly.

Follows ATC directives, without misapprehensions and is cognizant of the entry points and the approach procedure.
Places wingman to the right position for BREAK execution and directs the formation to the BREAK of active RWY.
Follows landing pattern procedures, as described in LAPs.

items.name: TURNING REJOIN
execution: 1/ Executes turning rejoin in Fingertip, or any other formation type after T/O, according to the leader’s command or the briefing analysis.
2/ Executes turning rejoin after pitch out.
3/ Executes rejoin in any other case, following the formation leader’s command.

general_criteria.text: Never points the velocity vector at the formation leader until his/her stabilization in route.
Is cognizant of the Aspect Angle, Angle Off and pursuit curve concept.
Controls the A/C in a smooth and solid manner.
Initially approaches the leading A/C at the same altitude and afterwards descends at the wing’s level.
Continuously keeps visual on the formation leader.
If overshoot is unavoidable, he/she informs the formation leader timely and executes Overshoot safely.
Executes turning tactical rejoin according to Techniques and Procedures Manual.

items.name: OVERSHOOT
execution: When executing the Training Exercise, SP executes Overshoot, when approaching for rejoin with excessive Overtake, bank or angle and estimating that he/she won’t make it to save a rejoin.
conditions: 2/ The formation leader, following wingman’s report, maintains his/her attitude until wingman overshoots.
3/ Overshoot is executed by IP’s order or by SP’s initiative when integration is not fully assured or for training reasons (pre-planned maneuver).

general_criteria.text: Timely informs the formation leader and:
In turn:
Passes safely behind and lower No1’s 6 o'clock and never above or below the leading A/C.
Cross No1’s 6 o’clock with a minimum spacing at least two (2) ship lengths.
Reposition to rejoin from inside leader’s turn in a time manner.
In straight ahead:
Executes a break out without affecting the leader’s flight path.
Try not to overshoot 3/9 o’clock of leader.
Rejoins without abrupt maneuvers.

parameters.notes: Τυπώνεται χωρίς ± — μονή τιμή ανά κωδικό.
Τυπώνεται χωρίς ± — μονή τιμή ανά κωδικό.

Οι εισαγωγικές γραμμές («Timely informs the formation leader and:», «In turn:», «In straight ahead:») καταχωρήθηκαν με key=null, στη σειρά του εγγράφου. Τα κλειδιά a/b/c ΔΕΝ είναι μοναδικά μέσα στο item — απαιτείται group-aware χειρισμός downstream.
Πίνακας specific criteria στη σελ. PDF 68 (το item σπάει σε γύρισμα σελίδας 67→68, με επανάληψη της κεφαλίδας πίνακα και ΔΙΑΦΟΡΕΤΙΚΟ πλέγμα στηλών).

ΑΒΕΒΑΙΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΡΜΗΝΕΙΑΣ: οι τιμές τυπώνονται ΧΩΡΙΣ «±». Δεν προκύπτει από το κείμενο αν είναι μέγιστη επιτρεπτή απόκλιση (≤200'/≤80') ή ονομαστική τιμή. Επειδή η αυστηρότερη βαθμίδα (κωδ. 3) έχει ΜΙΚΡΟΤΕΡΗ τιμή, πιθανότερη ερμηνεία = ανώτατο όριο απόκλισης. Χαρακτηρίστηκε ως nominal_change / interpolation undefined.
Ασυνέπεια πηγής μέσα στον ΙΔΙΟ πίνακα: «DISTANCE BEHIND No1 (feet)» με ΛΑΤΙΝΙΚΟ «No1», ενώ «ALTITUDE FROM Νο1 (feet)» με ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΑ Ν (U+039D) + ο (U+03BF).
Ασυνέπεια αποστρόφων στο κριτήριο a/ της ομάδας «In turn»: «No1’s» με U+2019 αλλά «o'clock» με ASCII U+0027 (στο b/ και τα δύο U+2019). Διατηρήθηκαν verbatim.

Informs the formation leader in time.
